DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis

Based on your history of a self-resolving ankle attack, the current knee swelling, urinary pain, sexual activity, and a family history of autoimmune disease, the pattern strongly suggests Reactive Arthritis. This condition often follows an infection of the urinary or gastrointestinal tract and affects joints asymmetrically. Do you have any eye symptoms like redness, pain, or light sensitivity, or any recent skin rashes on your palms or soles?
